lines.text: The men of Ephraim crossed the Jordan to Zaphon and threatened to burn Jephthah's house down with him inside.
Jephthah said he risked his life and crossed over to the Ammonites, and the LORD delivered them into his hand.
Jephthah gathered the men of Gilead and fought Ephraim, and the Gileadites captured the fords of the Jordan leading to Ephraim.
The Gileadites killed anyone who said Sibboleth at the fords of the Jordan, and 42,000 Ephraimites were killed.
Jephthah judged Israel six years and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead, and Ibzan of Bethlehem judged next.
